title: How Air Conditioning Evolved ❄️ From Wet Reeds to Heat Pumps #shorts #engineering
description:
Summer heat used to be something you just survived. From wet reeds in Egyptian windows and Persian wind catchers to shipped lake ice, Willis Carrier's 1902 machine, window units, and today's split ACs and heat pumps. Follow for more How It Evolved!
